sv.title: Camilla lurades att godkänna Klarna-köp – får ingen hjälp
sv.summary: Camilla Andersson trodde att hon pratade med Swedbanks säkerhetsavdelning. Hon fick veta att bedragare tagit lån i hennes namn, och för att stoppa dem uppmanades hon att legitimera sig med BankID. – De var så otroligt proffsiga. Jag följde bara med. Jag var ju i sån stress.

en.title: Camilla was tricked into approving Klarna purchases – gets no help
en.summary: Camilla Andersson believed she was speaking with Swedbank's security department. She was told that fraudsters had taken out loans in her name, and to stop them she was asked to verify her identity with BankID. "They were so incredibly professional. I just went along with it. I was under such stress."
